Karyotype: At least three (≥3) unrelated chromosomal abnormalities in one clone.
Must not include other class-defining alterations (e.g., core-binding factor translocations, t(8;21), inv(16), APL, etc.).
Excludes simple hyperdiploid karyotypes with ≥3 trisomies but no structural changes.
Two or more monosomies of autosomes (e.g., −5, −7, −17, etc.), excluding loss of X or Y alone
One autosomal monosomy plus at least one structural chromosomal abnormality, again not including core-binding factor AML (e.g., t(8;21), inv(16)).
TP53: Study limitation aknowledgment: Due to lack of routine access to SNP arrays or FISH for detection of copy-neutral LOH at 17p13, assessment of TP53 allelic state was limited to NGS-based mutation profiling and conventional karyotyping. Thus, cases with monoallelic mutations and undetected cnLOH may have been misclassified.
NGS: 1. report higly pathogenic mutations (A, according to ClinVar) in the boxes
2. write likely pathogenic or unknown mutations (B and C according to ClinVar) in the notes
